from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document record extracted from a document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of legal document, e.g., 判决书，裁定书")
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="The broad legal category, e.g., 行政，民事，刑事")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated records for all documents."""
    documents: list[DocumentRecord]
